## Projects

### Q: What is Geo-Guardian?
**A:** Geo-Guardian is a real-time danger zone management platform. It features a React/Leaflet admin control dashboard where operators can draw customized hazard polygon areas. These are computed on a Node/Express backend using MongoDB 2dsphere indexes to check if connected mobile clients cross boundaries, sending alerts via Socket.io in under 100ms.

### Q: Tell me about NoteMate.
**A:** NoteMate is an AI study planner and productivity workspace. Users can manage draggable sticky notes and archive files in an interactive dashboard. It uses a secure Express API proxy to connect to the NVIDIA Llama3 API to generate optimized academic study calendars in markdown format.

### Q: What is Sow & Grow?
**A:** Sow & Grow is a voice-first AI mobile assistant app for farmers. Built with Flutter and Dart, it uses Gemini Flash 2.0 to offer natural chat interaction, image uploads for plant disease diagnosis, local text-to-speech/speech-to-text packages, and interactive OpenStreetMap overlays showcasing regional disease heatmaps.

### Q: What is PDF Flow?
**A:** PDF Flow is a browser-based, zero-clutter file conversion and manipulation tool. It converts DOCX, PPT, XLSX, and images to PDFs and merges documents entirely in the browser memory using `pdf-lib` without uploading private documents to external servers.

### Q: What is the Visitor Parking Tracker?
**A:** It is a smart parking slot booking dashboard built with Next.js 15, React 19, and Tailwind CSS. It uses React Hook Form for license plate parsing and connects directly to Firebase Authentication and Firestore NoSQL collections for real-time occupancy updates.

# Mahaveer K - Projects & Case Studies

Detailed breakdown of production-ready applications engineered by Mahaveer K.

## 1. Geo-Guardian
- **Tagline**: Real-time danger zone management platform
- **Category**: Full Stack Development
- **Live Demo**: [https://geo-guardian.netlify.app/](https://geo-guardian.netlify.app/)
- **GitHub Repository**: [https://github.com/MAHAVEER-IT/Geo-Guardian](https://github.com/MAHAVEER-IT/Geo-Guardian)
- **Tech Stack**: React, Vite, Leaflet, React Leaflet, Leaflet Draw, Socket.io Client, Axios, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB Atlas (2dsphere index)

### Challenge
Managing physical danger zones on map interfaces and broadcasting safety alerts to tourists/operators in real-time requires a bidirectional socket bridge and high-performance spatial calculation indices.

### Solution
Created a React + Leaflet control panel integrated with Leaflet Draw for active polygon editing, bound to a Node.js + Express backend. Coordinates are saved as GeoJSON polygons with 2dsphere indexes in MongoDB Atlas. Location proximity checks run on a sub-100ms pipeline and alert mobile clients instantly via Socket.io.

### Key Highlights
- Draw and modify custom danger zones using an interactive Leaflet Draw polygon interface.
- Real-time GPS coordinate logging and location searching utilizing Nominatim API integration.
- Sub-100ms toast notifications and alerts triggered on mobile boundary breaches.

## 2. NoteMate
- **Tagline**: AI study planner & productivity dashboard
- **Category**: Artificial Intelligence / Productivity
- **Live Demo**: [https://note-mate-sage.vercel.app/](https://note-mate-sage.vercel.app/)
- **GitHub Repository**: [https://github.com/MAHAVEER-IT/Note-Mate](https://github.com/MAHAVEER-IT/Note-Mate)
- **Tech Stack**: React, Vite, NVIDIA API, React Router, Context API, React Draggable, Tailwind CSS, Axios, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB

### Challenge
Integrating complex, responsive study calendars and draggable boards with real-time AI generation can slow down browser main loops and expose secure keys on the client-side.

### Solution
Built NoteMate with React and Vite using Context API for structured CRUD. Draggable sticky notes leverage React Draggable, while the AI Study Planner delegates prompts securely to an Express server proxy that invokes the NVIDIA API (Meta Llama 3 70B model), returning instant markdown study schedules.

### Key Highlights
- AI Study Planner generating structured, customized academic calendars using NVIDIA API prompts.
- Draggable sticky notes that persist position coordinates and color codes across active browser sessions.
- Comprehensive note management featuring archive categories, color-coded filters, and JWT-secured routes.

## 3. Sow & Grow
- **Tagline**: Voice-first AI farm companion app
- **Category**: Mobile Application
- **Live Demo**: [Canva Video Demonstration](https://www.canva.com/design/DAGrAd4CWMI/JwQ19kPFiNsjxFi0YFJ9_A/watch?utm_content=DAGrAd4CWMI&utm_campaign=designshare&utm_medium=link2&utm_source=uniquelinks&utlId=h0409f5f144)
- **GitHub Repository**: [https://github.com/MAHAVEER-IT/Sow-Grow](https://github.com/MAHAVEER-IT/Sow-Grow)
- **Tech Stack**: Flutter, Dart, Provider, Gemini AI (2.0 Flash), Firebase, Flutter Map, OpenStreetMap, TTS (Text-to-Speech), STT (Speech-to-Text)

### Challenge
Providing accessible, interactive agricultural guidelines to rural farmers with low internet speeds and varied literacy levels.

### Solution
Designed a voice-friendly Flutter client using local TTS/STT packages. Implemented Gemini Flash 2.0 via a REST service layer (FarmCare) to handle plant image diagnoses, paired with a local-first Flutter Map dashboard showing geospatial plant disease heatmaps.

### Key Highlights
- **FarmHelper AI**: Conversational voice assistant featuring Gemini Flash 2.0 chat, image uploads, and Speech-to-Text.
- **Livestocare Suite**: Simple tracker registry for livestock records, vaccination dates, and SMS reminders.
- **Disease Heatmap**: Interactive OpenStreetMap rendering overlay layers of diagnosed crop/animal infections.

## 4. PDF Flow
- **Tagline**: Elegant browser-based document converter
- **Category**: Web Utility
- **Live Demo**: [https://pdf-flow-smoky.vercel.app/](https://pdf-flow-smoky.vercel.app/)
- **GitHub Repository**: [https://github.com/MAHAVEER-IT/PDF_FLOW.git](https://github.com/MAHAVEER-IT/PDF_FLOW.git)
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js 15, React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, pdf-lib, SWC Compiler, HTML5 Files API

### Challenge
Performing file conversions and document editing in-browser quickly without crashing user interface threads or sending private data to server pipelines.

### Solution
Leveraged the browser's raw processing performance. Used pdf-lib to perform document merges, image compilations, and format operations entirely on the client, resulting in near-instant outputs with maximum security.

### Key Highlights
- Client-side conversion models for DOCX, PPT, XLSX, and images straight into optimized PDF formats.
- Fast PDF merging pipeline combining bulk PDFs into a single file with custom page indices.
- Zero login required, zero remote bandwidth overhead, keeping private documents completely local.

## 5. Visitor Parking Tracker
- **Tagline**: Smart parking slots registration portal
- **Category**: Full Stack Development
- **Live Demo**: [https://visitor-parking-tracker.vercel.app/](https://visitor-parking-tracker.vercel.app/)
- **GitHub Repository**: [https://github.com/MAHAVEER-IT/visitor-parking-tracker](https://github.com/MAHAVEER-IT/visitor-parking-tracker)
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js 15, React 19, Tailwind CSS, React Hook Form, Firebase Auth, Firestore NoSQL

### Challenge
Providing a responsive, real-time booking form that updates occupancy immediately while ensuring secure validation across role permissions.

### Solution
Built a Next.js App Router portal integrated with Firebase client SDKs. Used React Hook Form for client-side license plate formatting, writing registrations directly to Firebase Firestore to trigger instant listener layout updates.

### Key Highlights
- Secure Google Sign-In and profile authorization using Firebase Authentication.
- React Hook Form validation mapping license formats (Two Wheeler, Four Wheeler, Heavy, EV).
- Firestore real-time listeners syncing parking availability status indicators instantly across operators.

## 6. Bank Inishit
- **Tagline**: Unified multi-bank utility app
- **Category**: Mobile Application
- **Live Demo**: [Google Drive APK Folder](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/13j3pnF7rVRWrvD1OvyUghWhdSVP8HYQR)
- **GitHub Repository**: [https://github.com/MAHAVEER-IT/bank_inish](https://github.com/MAHAVEER-IT/bank_inish)
- **Tech Stack**: Flutter, Dart, Firebase, Google Maps API, Currency Converter API, Syncfusion Charts

### Challenge
Accessing essential banking tools across different banks in India without installing multiple heavy, slow corporate apps.

### Solution
Developed a unified banking application supporting SBI, Indian Bank, Union Bank, and KVB. Consolidates balance check hotlines, ATM blocking shortcuts, Google Maps branch trackers, and Gold/Personal loan calculators.

### Key Highlights
- Toll-free banking shortcuts using integrated dialers for rapid balance checks and card blocks.
- Interactive nearby ATM and branch locator utilizing integrated Google Maps API markers.
- Gold and personal loan calculators referencing scheme data tables with Syncfusion Charts.
